column1: # Stressed-vowel aperture for Catalan words whose spelling does not record it.
# Catalan orthography marks aperture only when the word carries a written
# accent: é/ó are close, è/ò are open. For a stressed e or o with no accent the
# letters are silent on the question — pedra is [ˈpeðɾə] but terra is [ˈtɛrə] —
# so the transcriber has to guess, and marks the result approximate. This file
# removes the guess for the words it lists.
# Format: word <TAB> the IPA symbol for its stressed vowel. Only e, ɛ, o and ɔ
# appear; every other vowel is already determined by the rules.
# This is a correction list, not a dictionary. It is deliberately short and
# holds only entries worth being confident about — a wrong entry here is worse
# than the honest "approx." marker it replaces, because it presents a guess as a
# fact. Inflected forms are covered by the suffix stripping in CatalanIpa, so
# listing the lemma also covers its plural, its feminine and its regular verb
# forms. Extending it is the intended way to improve the transcriber.
# Kept flat and alphabetical on purpose: an earlier draft grouped entries under
# "close" and "open" headings and several ended up filed under the wrong one.
